title: A week of every train in New York City
description:
A week of every train in New York City, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the New York City limits are faded and not counted. Colours: B/D/F/M, 4/5/6, 1/2/3, N/Q/R/W, A/C/E and 7, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 591 trains, Tuesday at 8:25 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. Long Island Rail Road and Metro-North Railroad changed their timetables during October and have fewer than three usable October Mondays, so their Monday and Friday each use one typical date.
